JOIN result r ON ra.sk_result_id = r.sk_id
JOIN result_citations rc ON r.sk_id = rc.sk_result_id_cited

SELECT r.sk_id, r.title, r.description, r.keywords
FROM result r
JOIN result_fos rf ON r.sk_id = rf.sk_result_id
JOIN fos f ON f.sk_id = rf.sk_fos_id
JOIN fos f2 ON f.sk_id = rf.sk_fos_id
WHERE f.label = 'basic medicine'
and f2.label = 'general physics'
and r.type = 'publication';

question: Who is the publisher with the most publications in the DARIAHEU community?
SQL:
SELECT r.publisher, COUNT(*) AS publications_count
FROM result r
    JOIN result_community rc ON r.sk_id = rc.sk_result_id
    JOIN community c ON rc.sk_community_id = c.sk_id
WHERE
    c.name = 'DARIAH EU'
GROUP BY r.publisher
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Return me the non nano-technology publications by Nanann Zhao
SQL:

                      FROM result AS r
                               JOIN result_author AS ra ON ra.sk_result_id = r.sk_id
                               JOIN author AS a ON a.sk_id = ra.sk_author_id
                               JOIN result_fos AS rf ON CAST(rf.sk_result_id AS INT) = r.sk_id

SELECT DISTINCT publications.title
FROM publications

question: Return me the non nano-technology publications by Ms. Peili Wu

                      FROM result AS r
                               JOIN result_author AS ra ON ra.sk_result_id = r.sk_id
                               JOIN author AS a ON a.sk_id = ra.sk_author_id
                               JOIN result_fos AS rf ON CAST(rf.sk_result_id AS INT) = r.sk_id
                               JOIN fos as F ON f.sk_id = rf.sk_fos_id
                      WHERE a.fullname = 'Peili Wu'
                        AND r.type = 'publication')
SELECT DISTINCT publications.title
FROM publications
